name: Italian Meat sauce
description: Italian sausage meat sauce, this is a 8 servings make less if you want less. you can make the tomato sauce yourself but it takes forever.
ingredients: 2 pounds italian sausage or alt meat
1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes (if you want)
steps: Finely chop onion
To a pot or large sauce pan add olive oil, yellow onion and a pinch of salt. Stir and cook 8 to 10 minutes slightly below medium to soften
Mince garlic
Add garlic and cook for 1 more minute
Raise heat to medium
Add italian sausage or alternative ground beef and break up into small bits
Cook until browned
Add the italian seasoning and a pinch of red pepper flakes. Stir and cook 1 to 2 minutes.
Pour in the tomato sauce, add parmesan cheese and season with 1 tsp salt, black pepper and a pinch of sugar. Stir well to incorporate all of the ingredients.
Cover, reduce the temperature to medium-low and simmer for 15 minutes

name: Baked Mostaccioli
description: Chicago land area regional baked pasta. Barnellis style. Time depends on sauce methods
ingredients: Meat sauce (make it or buy it)
steps: Set oven pre-heat to 350
Cook pasta using heavily salted water until al dente or slightly less
Drain water, add olive oil, and mix
Warm red sauce to a near simmer
Add pasta to red sauce (should contain garlic and italian sausage) recipe for candidate sauce available
Toss pasta in warmed sauce
Add pasta to baking dish and generously cover in shredded mozzarella and grated asiago
Bake until cheese is melted bubbling and beginning to darken in spots

name: Rosemary Butter Steak
description: adaptable for multiple cuts of steak.
steps: Take steak out of fridge and add salt and pepper on all sides.
Crush garlic cloves, mince for more garlic flavor.
Remove rosemary off of 1 twig, leave other for later.
Set heat to med/high and add pan at least twice as large as steak for 3 mins. for cast iron heat for 5 to 7 mins.
Mix herbs (not the second twig of rosemary) and melted butter in a small bowl
Add olive oil and steak to pan on one side
Add the butter mixture to the other side of the pan
As steak cooks on each side spoon over butter mixture.
When finished cooking on both sides remove from heat and brush butter over using second rosemary twig.
Allow steak to rest with rosemary on top.

name: Air fryer garlic herb salmon
steps: Crush garlic cloves then mince
Finely chop basil
Microwave butter in small bowl for 5 to 10 seconds
Combine and mix butter garlic basil
Salt and pepper all sides of salmon
Pre heat air fryer to 400
Add salmon and pour over butter mixture and place lemon on top
Cook for 6-8 mins
Squeeze remaining lemon from top of salmon and discard it
